data.name: Immunity to Magic
data.description: An adamantine golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance, except as noted below.  Transmute metal to wood slows an adamantine golem for 1d4 rounds, during which time its damage reduction is reduce to 15/adamantine (no save).
